name: Region-Anchored Visual Citation
mechanism: Carries stable document version page and bounding-box or table-cell identifiers from retrieval through generation into verifiable citations.
use_when: Answers depend on charts tables figures forms or layout
Users must inspect the exact visual evidence
avoid_when: Coordinates are discarded during parsing or rendering
expected_effects: Detection of correct-page but wrong-region answers
failure_modes: Citation points to a page but not supporting region
Sensitive hidden regions appear in crops
